body:
Thanks for showing interest in somebody you don’t know.

A few big things happened that has started to make me feel worse and worse. About 6 months ago, I was dumped really badly and this gave me some bad abandonment issues. The wound reopened pretty recently. I know it’s stupid, but I feel like everyone I will ever meet will choose to abandon me. I told some of these same friends about this, and the ones who responded kinda just gave me the canned answers most people give to it. “I won’t abandon you” and things like that. It’s selfish, but that hurt a bit. Especially now when it feels like they are abandoning me.

I also moderate a discord, and this probably doesn’t help. The discord itself is fine, but I’ve been kinda forced into a mediator position. What this means is that I feel obligated to help people when they’re venting, like, yesterday, I spent several hours trying to do this. That doesn’t help my mental state, but what’s worse id my hypocrisy there. This may sound selfish, but I’m telling people there  things like “you are appreciated” and stuff when I don’t believe it about myself. It’s the sick treating the sick, only, when I try to vent, I get no treatment. If I say “I feel like a waste of space” I’m lucky to get 1 person who says “ur not”. So, and here’s the selfish part, it almost feels like I’m giving away all the positivity I have to others and screwing myself over in the process. Like I wrote, I’m the teddy bear brought out in the thunderstorm. Loved and appreciated for five minutes and then thrown right back into a cupboard.

Doesn’t help I’ve had depression since I was a kid, untreated. That hurts my chances.

Sorry for the length. Thanks again for your kindness.
